description.en: Inkscape extension to export SVG documents as Windows ICO files. Supports multiple sizes (16x16, 32x32, 48x48) with automatic conversion from vector to raster format.
description.it: Estensione Inkscape per esportare documenti SVG come file ICO di Windows. Supporta multiple dimensioni (16x16, 32x32, 48x48) con conversione automatica da vettoriale a raster.

releases.notes: Added support for Inkscape 1.0+, improved PNG to ICO conversion, better error handling
